title: Future participles and fact clauses
summary: Describe what will happen and what hasn't with `-jAk` and `-mAdYk` (*okajak kitabym*, *görmedik ýerim*), turn a whole clause into the object of *bilmek*, *eşitmek* or *aýtmak* with `-dYgY` (*Onuň gelendigini bilýärin*, *Geljekdigini aýtdy*), and put a noun doer in the genitive (*Aýnanyň okan kitaby*).
